notes.title: Update August 22, 2017 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Greetings Travelers,

Today's update contains a few bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fix for bug where a rabbit is not killed if it’s the last shot in the slingshot
[*] Russian localization improvements	
[*] Fix for bug that would change your selected recipe after crafting it
[*] Fixed a bug that meant players could join a town despite having hit the 10 player maximum.  This would result in them being unable to see their house in the town view.

[b]Players with this issue will need to move towns via the stagecoach; all affected players will receive 10,000 Chits in order to help with the move.[/b]

[*] Some flags, including Russia and the US, were not appearing in the stagecoach.
[*] Fixed an instance where Beatrice’s text is in Japanese, when the game is set to Korean.
[/list]
If you've run into any issues and need account help, please [url=http://thetrailfrontierchallenge.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new]contact support[/url]. 

Thank you and safe travels!

[*] Some flags, including Russia and the US, were not appearing in the stagecoach.

notes.title: Update August 18, 2017 - Bug Fixes & Balancing
notes.content:
Greetings Travelers, 

Here is some information on today's update:
[list]
[*] We have fixed the Mayor timer showing an incorrect countdown timer.
[*] We have fixed minigame trees appearing in rivers which made characters walk into the river and get stuck.
[*] Some German Translation corrections have been made.
[*]  The Almanac will now open to the last tab you viewed before closing it.
[*] Corrected an issue that caused players to get stuck while minigame hunting.
[*] Some balancing adjustments have been made. 
[/list]
We hope your trail adventures are going smoothly and thank you for your support. 

Safe travels!
